Let

\[
f(x,y)=(-1)^{x\cdot(My+c)+g(y)}.
\]

Compute the transform:

\[
(\mathcal F f)(u,v)
=2^{-8}\sum_{x,y}(-1)^{x\cdot(My+c)+g(y)+x\cdot v+y\cdot u}.
\]

The sum over \(x\) vanishes unless \(My+c+v=0\), so

\[
(\mathcal F f)(u,v)
=(-1)^{g(M^{-1}(v+c))+M^{-1}(v+c)\cdot u}.
\]

Thus \(\mathcal Ff=f\) iff, for all \(u,v\),

\[
M^{-1}(v+c)=Mv+c
\]

and

\[
g(M^{-1}(v+c))=g(v).
\]

Hence

\[
M^2=I,\qquad Mc=c,
\]

and \(g\) is invariant under

\[
T(v)=Mv+c.
\]

Write \(M=I+N\). Over \(\mathbb F_2\), \(M^2=I\) means \(N^2=0\). Let \(r=\operatorname{rank}N\), so \(0\le r\le 4\). The number of such \(N\) of rank \(r\) is

\[
A_r={8\brack r}_2{8-r\brack r}_2|\operatorname{GL}(r,2)|.
\]

For fixed \(N\), \(c\in\ker N\). There are two cases.

If \(c\in\operatorname{im}N\), then the affine involution has a fixed point and is conjugate to the linear map \(v\mapsto Mv\). The dimension of invariant quadratic Boolean polynomials with the imposed value condition is

\[
d_0(r)=r^2+r+s+rs+\binom{s}{2},
\qquad s=8-2r.
\]

If \(c\notin\operatorname{im}N\), possible only when \(s>0\), a normal form gives

\[
d_1(r)=\frac{r(r+1)}2+r+k+\binom{k}{2},
\qquad k=7-r.
\]

So the total count is

\[
\sum_{r=0}^4
A_r\left(2^r2^{d_0(r)}
+\bigl(2^{8-r}-2^r\bigr)2^{d_1(r)}\right),
\]

with the second term omitted for \(r=4\).

The required values are:

\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
r&A_r&d_0(r)&d_1(r)\\
\hline
0&1&36&28\\
1&32385&29&23\\
2&42165270&24&20\\
3&2529916200&21&19\\
4&4047865920&20&-
\end{array}
\]

This gives

\[
\boxed{147742197217755136}.
\]
